headline: Nissan Disables Repair Systems Following Cyberattack Attempt
summary: Nissan shut down an IT system used for vehicle repairs following a cyberattack attempt. The ongoing outage threatens to delay electronic repairs and key fob servicing for vehicle owners.
why: Nissan Motor Co. is a major global automobile manufacturer. System outages can disrupt dealership operations, delay vehicle maintenance, and generate unexpected remediation costs.

impacts.name: Nissan Motor Co., Ltd.
impacts.why: Operational disruptions from system outages may temporarily affect customer service efficiency and increase IT costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
